New message in #sales:

sarah: @lobu what's our pipeline total this month?

input.text: Hi Sarah! I don't have access to the sales pipeline data or CRM database, so I can't pull that figure for you. You'll want to check the pipeline report directly in the CRM, or ask someone on the team who has dashboard access to pull the current-month total.

content.text: I replied to Sarah in #sales. I don't have access to any CRM or sales-pipeline data source (no database, dashboard, or reporting tools are wired up to me here), so rather than guess at a number, I pointed her to the right places to get the actual figure.
